'''AV-6R7''' was a [[V-series droid supervisor]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]], overseeing the [[Labor droid|work droids]] constructing the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] [[superweapon]] and acting as a liaison to the ''[[Executor]]'', [[flagship]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. The [[droid]] was at one point deprived of his [[Limb|arms]] as a punishment. He was present in a crew pit on board the ''Executor's'' [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] during the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]] and was [[Death|obliterated]] when a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] crashed into the Imperial [[Starship|vessel]].

==Biography==
AV-6R7 was a [[V-series droid supervisor]] that served the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="New Edition" /> He was assigned as a liaison to the ''[[Executor]]'', the [[flagship]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]],<ref name="BuildR2" /> and oversaw [[Labor droid|work droids]] that were building the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] in the [[Endor system]]. The [[droid]] was at one point deprived of his [[Limb|arms]] for failing to keep track of a faulty [[power droid]].<ref name="New Edition" />

In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> AV-6R7—his arms intact—was working at a bank of controls in a crew pit<ref name="BuildR2" /> on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''Executor'' when the bridge received a request for deactivation of the [[Planetary shield|shield]] around the [[moon]] [[Endor]] from the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Tydirium]]''. The [[shuttle]] was allowed to proceed to Endor, but was in fact carrying rebels, and was a one of the first stages of an [[Battle of Endor|attack]] on the [[Death Star]]. AV-6R7 remained in the crew pit on the bridge during the ensuing battle. As the battle progressed, an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[pilot]]ed by [[Green Leader]] [[Arvel Crynyd]]<ref name="New Edition" /> crashed into the bridge<ref name="ROTJ" /> and obliterated AV-6R7 along with the Imperial staff he served.<ref name="BuildR2" />

==Characteristics==
AV-6R7 was a [[supervisor droid]] with [[Color|black]] plating.<ref name="New Edition" />

==Behind the scenes==
AV-6R7 appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ" /> in scenes filmed on Stage 1 at [[Elstree Studios]] on [[February 8]], [[1982]].<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], AV-6R7 was first identified in [[2017]] in the "[[Droid Directory]]" section of the [[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2 20|twentieth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2]]'' magazine series. The issue identified AV-6R7 as an [[EV-series supervisor droid]]<ref name="BuildR2" /> but the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' instead labeled the droid as a V-series droid supervisor. This article assumes the later source to be correct.<ref name="New Edition" /> The name [[AV-6R7/Legends|AV-6R7]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
